items.statement: The investigation reports explicit candidate generation, deduplication, validation and coverage for each of the eight named complexes.
items.expected: Per-complex candidate and retained-state counts plus a stopping/coverage statement are present.

items.statement: The interaction energy uses fragment-consistent counterpoise bookkeeping and validates charge, multiplicity and stationary-state status.
items.expected: The report identifies fragment energies, counterpoise treatment, charge/multiplicity checks and stationary or explicitly qualified alternative states.

items.statement: The eight requested cluster identities are AI2, AI-[NF2]-, AI-[NTf2]-, AI-[NNf2]-, AI-[OTf]-, AI-[BF4]-, AI-[DCA]- and AI-Br-.
items.expected: All eight IDs are reported without identity ambiguity.

items.statement: The reported interaction energies are the Table 5 values for the seven anion clusters and AI dimer.
items.expected: The submitted per-complex energies agree with the hidden Table 5 values within the rule tolerances.
